test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five girls Priya, Usha, Riya, Shreya and Tina wrote a novel. The one who wrote first gave it to Riya. The one who wrote last took it from Priya. Tina was not the first or the last to write. There were two writers in between Usha and Priya. Who was the last to write the novel.
solution:
**Explanation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72cce87f86f92d7e7006ac9fc47c34983c6f9fecf7278184389b513d93345109.png] 

STEP1. The one who wrote first gave it to Riya so Riya becomes the second to receive novel.

STEP2. The one who wrote last took it from Priya so Priya becomes 4th out of 5 girls to receive the novel.

STEP3.Tina was not the first or the last to write. Here Riya and Priya have already been placed at 2nd and 4th position respectively so Tina will be the 3rd girl to receive the novel.

STEP4. There were two writers in between Usha and Priya and to follow this logic we will place Usha at 1st and the remaining 5th posotion will be taken by Shreya.

**Hence, Shreya is the correct answer.**
